docs.text: Welcome to the Maximo Monitor 9.2 Juniper Mist Integration Lab Info This hands-on lab demonstrates how to integrate Juniper Mist with IBM Maximo Monitor 9.2.4 & 9.3 FC . In this lab, you will explore Juniper Mist and learn how to set up its integration with Maximo Monitor. You will perform step-by-step exercises to configure Juniper Mist, synchronize site hierarchies, assign Maximo Manage locations, configure Business Unit mappings, and subscribe locations to ingest real-time events. By the end of the lab, you will understand how Wi-Fi telemetry and location intelligence from Juniper Mist are transformed into actionable real-time occupancy and presence analytics across sites, buildings, floors, and business units to drive workplace optimization, capacity planning, and facilities operations. Lab Exercises You will complete the following exercises: Juniper Mist Overview Configure Juniper Mist Integration Edit Juniper Mist Integration Site Synchronization Overview Assign Maximo Manage Locations Subscribe Juniper Mist Locations Access Points & Device Types Occupancy & Presence Calculated Metrics Unsubscribe & Unassign Workflows Delete Juniper Mist Integration Note Expected time needed to run the complete lab: 1 hour Updated: 2026-10-27

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how DeviceTypes and Access Points are automatically created and assigned upon floor subscription. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Subscribed at least one Juniper Mist Floor Device Type & Occupancy Metrics Creation Once a Floor is subscribed, a background scheduler automatically prepares the selected location for MIST data collection: DeviceType Creation : Once a floor is successfully subscribed, the required DeviceType is created for the subscribed floor. Access Point Discovery : The Access Points (APs) are then discovered and created as Monitor devices under that device type. Access points are assigned to the subscribed floor location. Business Unit Metrics : Creates the required metrics for each Business Unit, including total and other business units. WebSocket Connection : The Site of the subscribed floor is connected to the WebSocket listener, allowing Monitor to receive live user events from Juniper Mist. Viewing Device Type Overview & Metrics To view the generated DeviceType and its metrics: Click the Device Type link from the Floor Details tab to open the Device Type Overview page. In the Data tab, expand Metrics to view the available Business Unit metrics. Selecting a metric displays the corresponding data received for that metric.

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how to assign Maximo Manage Locations to synchronized Juniper Mist Sites, Buildings, and Floors. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Verified that Juniper Mist sites, buildings, and floors are synchronized Assign Maximo Manage Location to a Mist Site To assign a Maximo Manage Location to a Mist Site from the Site List page: From the Action menu (⋮) for the required Mist Site, select Assign Location . A modal window will open displaying the Maximo Manage hierarchy. Expand the hierarchy in the following order: Organization → Site → System → Location Select the required Manage Location from the hierarchy. Click Assign Location to complete the mapping. The selected Maximo Manage Location will be successfully assigned to the corresponding Mist Site. Assign Maximo Manage Location to a Mist Building To assign a Maximo Manage Location to a Mist Building from the Building details page: Navigate to the Building Details page for the site. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required Mist Building, select Assign Location . A modal window will open displaying the Maximo Manage Location hierarchy. It will show the child locations of the selected site manage location in the hierarchy. Expand the hierarchy. Select the required Manage Location from the hierarchy. Click Assign Location to complete the mapping. The selected Maximo Manage Location will be successfully assigned to the corresponding Mist Building. Assign Maximo Manage Location to a Mist Floor To assign a Maximo Manage Location to a Mist Floor from the Floor details page: Navigate to the Floor Details page. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required Mist Floor, select Assign Location . A modal window will open displaying the Maximo Manage Location hierarchy. It will show child locations of the selected site or building manage location in the hierarchy. Expand the hierarchy. Select the required Manage Location from the hierarchy. Click Assign Location to complete the mapping. The selected Maximo Manage Location will be successfully assigned to the corresponding Mist Floor.

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how to configure the Juniper Mist integration in IBM MAS Monitor, upload Business Unit mapping configurations, and set up the dynamic Business Unit Lookup API. Steps to Configure the Integration Log in to IBM MAS Monitor Access your MAS Monitor environment by logging in with your credentials in Maximo Application Suite. Navigate to Integrations Open the left-side navigation menu. Scroll to the Monitor applications list and select Setup → Integrations from the menu options. Add a New Integration On the Integrations screen, click the Add Integration button to start configuring a new integration. Select Juniper Mist as the Integration Type From the Integration Type list, select Juniper Mist and click Next . Step 1: Configure Juniper Mist Access In this step, provide the required Juniper Mist connection details: Integration Name : Specify a unique name for the integration. API URL : Enter your Juniper Mist cloud URL (for example, https://api.mist.com ). API Token / Secret : Enter the API access token obtained from your Juniper Mist organization. Organization ID : Enter the organization UUID from your Juniper Mist account. Click Next to proceed. These details are used to establish connectivity between Juniper Mist and IBM MAS Monitor. Step 2: Configure Business Unit (Optional) The Configure Business Unit step is used to upload the Business Unit (BU) mapping configuration file. A sample configuration file is available for download and reference. The uploaded file is used to resolve users to their respective Business Units. After uploading the file, the system displays the Business Units parsed from the configuration, allowing administrators to: Review the Business Unit mappings Validate the uploaded configuration Click Next to proceed. This is an optional step , and users can skip it if not needed. Step 3: Configure Business Unit Lookup API (Optional) The Configure Business Unit Lookup API step allows administrators to configure the API details required to resolve user identities to Business Units dynamically at runtime: BU Lookup API Endpoint : Enter the endpoint URL for user identity resolution. Authentication Details : Provide required authentication credentials (API key, bearer token, etc.). These settings enable IBM MAS Monitor to dynamically determine the appropriate Business Unit for users during runtime. Click Finish to complete the integration configuration. This is an optional step , and users can skip it. Verify Integration Once the integration is added successfully, its details will appear on the Integrations list page. Congratulations, you have successfully configured the Juniper Mist Integration in Maximo Monitor.
docs.title: 2. Configure Juniper Mist Integration

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how to delete the Juniper Mist integration from IBM Maximo Monitor. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Delete Juniper Mist Integration You can delete the Juniper Mist configuration if it is no longer required. However, this action has strict prerequisites. Prerequisites before deleting Before deleting the Juniper MIST Configuration, ensure that all Sites, Buildings, and Floors have been unassigned from their Maximo Manage Locations. Ensure that all MIST Floors are unsubscribed . Steps to Delete: Navigate to Setup → Integrations . Find the Juniper Mist configuration entry. Click the Action menu (⋮) next to the integration. Select Delete . A confirmation popup will appear. Click Delete to confirm. After confirmation, the configuration is deleted and the associated MIST Sites, Buildings, and Floors are removed from Monitor.

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how to edit an existing Juniper Mist configuration in IBM Maximo Monitor. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Edit Juniper Mist Configuration You can edit the Juniper Mist configuration from the Edit button provided with the configuration: Navigate to Setup → Integrations in the MAS Monitor application. Locate the Juniper Mist configuration from the integrations list. Click on the Action menu (⋮) next to the integration name. Select Edit from the action menu. You will be redirected to the Edit Juniper Mist configuration wizard: You can update the API URL , API Token / secret , and Organization ID from the Juniper Mist instance. docs.text: Overview about Juniper Mist Juniper Mist is a cloud-native, AI-driven networking and location intelligence platform that provides visibility into wireless and wired network infrastructure, connected devices, and location-aware services. IBM Maximo Monitor 9.2.4 and 9.3 FC provides native integration with Juniper Mist to leverage Wi-Fi connectivity and location data for real-time occupancy and presence analytics. The integration connects IBM Maximo Monitor with the Juniper Mist cloud platform through its APIs and real-time event interfaces, enabling data to be collected, processed, and presented through Monitor dashboards. Purpose of Using Juniper Mist in MAS Monitor Workplace Strategy & Activity IBM Global Real Estate (GRE) and enterprise workplace teams use the integration to understand workplace activity across sites, buildings, floors, and business units. Space Optimization & Capacity Planning Supports facility operations, space right-sizing, and capacity planning based on actual Wi-Fi presence. Real-Time Insights Transforms live connectivity events from Juniper Mist into aggregated workplace metrics viewed in Maximo Monitor dashboards. Business Unit Breakdown Resolves user information to respective Business Units (BUs) through configurable mappings or lookup APIs.

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will explore the automatically created Occupancy and Presence Count calculated metrics across Floor, Building, and Site locations. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Subscribed at least one floor, building, or site Occupancy & Presence Count Calculated Metrics Creation Once metrics are created for each Business Unit, the system automatically creates the required occupancy and presence calculated metrics for the subscribed floor, building, and site. When the user updates the BU Lookup CSV in the Juniper MIST configuration, a background scheduler automatically applies the updated Business Unit mappings across all already-subscribed Sites, Buildings, and Floors. 1. Floor Location Calculated Metrics To view the calculated metrics for a subscribed Floor: Navigate to the Floor Details tab on the Site Details page. Click the Mapped location link for the subscribed floor to open the Location Details page. In the Data tab, view the calculated metrics. Occupancy and presence count metrics generated at the floor level capture local utilization: OCCUPANCY_COUNT (Total & per Business Unit) PRESENCE_COUNT (Total & per Business Unit) 2. Building Location Calculated Metrics To view the calculated metrics for a subscribed Building: Navigate to the Building Details tab for the site. Click the Mapped location link for the subscribed building to open the Location Details page. In the Data tab, view the calculated metrics. Calculated metrics are aggregated across all subscribed floors within the building: BUILDING_OCCUPANCY_COUNT (Total & per Business Unit) BUILDING_PRESENCE_COUNT (Total & per Business Unit) 3. Site Location Calculated Metrics To view the calculated metrics for a subscribed Site: Navigate to the Mist Site List page. Click the Mapped location link for the subscribed site to open the Location Details page. In the Data tab, view the calculated metrics. Calculated metrics roll up across all buildings and floors within the site: SITE_OCCUPANCY_COUNT (Total & per Business Unit) SITE_PRESENCE_COUNT (Total & per Business Unit)

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will explore the synchronized Juniper Mist Sites, Buildings, and Floors, and understand the connection status indicators. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Configuration & Sync – Sites, Buildings & Floors Once the Maximo–Juniper Mist configuration is successfully completed, IBM MAS Monitor establishes a connection with the configured Juniper Mist organization. To access the site synchronization page: Navigate to the Integrations list page in IBM MAS Monitor. Locate your Juniper Mist integration entry in the list. Click the Configure site synchronization link in the corresponding row. The system internally triggers a scheduler to fetch and synchronize Juniper Mist hierarchy (Site, Building, Floor) from the configured organization. The Mist hierarchy synchronization may take some time after the configuration is completed, so the Site/Building/Floor may not appear immediately. Connection Status Indicators At the top of the Juniper Mist Site Synchronization page, check the connection status: Connected to Juniper Mist : Indicates that a successful connection has been established with Juniper Mist and site data can be retrieved. Not Connected to Juniper Mist : Indicates that the Mist instance is currently unreachable or the connection could not be established. Navigating Synchronized Sites, Buildings, and Floors The screen displays all Mist sites synchronized from the configured Mist organization, along with their buildings and floors. 1. Mist Site List Displays all sites retrieved from Juniper Mist, including the Site Name, Mapped Location status, and Subscription Status. 2. Building Details Click the Juniper Mist Site link from the Mist Site List page. The system redirects to the Building and Floor Details page for the selected Mist Site. The screen displays all Mist Buildings in the Building details tab associated with the selected Mist Site, along with their current mapping status. 3. Floor Details The Floor Details page can be accessed from the Floors tab on the Site Details page, displaying all floors associated with the site and building. Alternatively, floor details can be accessed from the Building Details page by clicking the Building Name link in the Building Details table. The screen displays all Mist Floors, along with their current Mapped location and Subscribe Status.

docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how to subscribe to Juniper Mist Floors, Buildings, and Sites to enable real-time data collection. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Assigned Maximo Manage Locations to the target Juniper Mist Site, Building, and Floor Subscribe Juniper Mist Floor To subscribe to a Juniper Mist Floor from the Floor Details page: The Subscribe action is available only after a Maximo Manage Location has been assigned to the Mist Floor. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required Mist Floor, select Subscribe . A confirmation dialog will appear to confirm the subscription. Click Subscribe to proceed. Once the subscription is successful, the selected Mist Floor status will be updated to Subscribed . Subscribe Juniper Mist Building To subscribe to a Juniper Mist Building from the Building Details page: The Subscribe action is available only after a Maximo Manage Location has been assigned to the Mist Building. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required Mist Building, select Subscribe . A confirmation dialog will appear. Click Subscribe to proceed. Subscribing to a Mist Building initiates the subscription process for all floors associated with that building. During the subscription process, the system validates whether each floor has a Maximo Manage Location assigned: Floors with an assigned location will be subscribed successfully. Floors without an assigned location will not be subscribed and will generate an error. If only some floors are successfully subscribed, the building will be marked as Partially Subscribed . In case of an error or partial subscription, the confirmation modal provides an option to download the error file for further review. Once the subscription is completed, the subscription status of the applicable Mist Building floors will be updated to Subscribed . Subscribe Juniper Mist Site To subscribe to a Juniper Mist Site from the Site List page: The Subscribe action is available only after a Maximo Manage Location has been assigned to the Mist Site. docs.text: Objectives In this Exercise you will learn how to Unsubscribe from Juniper Mist locations to stop data collection, and how to Unassign Maximo Manage locations. Before you begin: This Exercise requires that you have: Completed the pre-requisites required for all labs Completed the previous exercises Unsubscribing from Juniper Mist Locations Unsubscribing from a Juniper MIST Floor To stop data collection for a floor, unsubscribe from it first: The Unsubscribe option is available only when the MIST Floor is subscribed. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required MIST Floor, select Unsubscribe . A confirmation dialog appears. Click Unsubscribe to confirm. Unsubscribing stops the flow of data from Juniper MIST to Maximo Monitor. Once unsubscribe is completed successfully, the subscription status of the MIST Floor is updated to Unsubscribed . Unsubscribing from a Juniper MIST Building The Unsubscribe option is available only when a Maximo Manage Location is assigned to the MIST Building. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required MIST Building, select Unsubscribe . A confirmation dialog appears. Click Unsubscribe to confirm. Unsubscribing stops the flow of data from the Juniper Building to Maximo Monitor. During the unsubscribe process, the system checks whether a Maximo Manage Location is assigned to each Floor: Floors with an assigned location are unsubscribed successfully. Floors without an assigned location are not unsubscribed and are reported as errors. If only some Buildings or Floors are unsubscribed successfully, the Building is marked as Partially Unsubscribed . If an error or partial unsubscribe occurs, the confirmation dialog provides an option to download the error file for review. Once unsubscribe is completed successfully, the subscription status of the applicable MIST Floors is updated to Unsubscribed . Unsubscribing from a Juniper MIST Site To stop data collection for a site, unsubscribe from it first. The Unsubscribe option is available only when a Maximo Manage Location is assigned to the MIST Site. From the Action menu (⋮) for the required MIST Site, select Unsubscribe . A confirmation dialog appears. Click Unsubscribe to confirm. Unsubscribing stops the flow of data from Juniper MIST to Maximo Monitor. During the unsubscribe process, the system checks whether a Maximo Manage Location is assigned to each Building and Floor: Buildings and Floors with an assigned location are unsubscribed successfully. Buildings and Floors without an assigned location are not unsubscribed and are reported as errors. If only some Buildings or Floors are unsubscribed successfully, the Site is marked as Partially Unsubscribed . Once unsubscribe is completed successfully, the subscription status of the applicable MIST Floors is updated to Unsubscribed . A confirmation dialog appears to confirm the removal of the Maximo Manage Location from the Floor. The dialog also provides an option to delete the calculated metrics associated with the location. Click Unassign Location to complete the action. The selected Maximo Manage Location is successfully unassigned from the corresponding MIST Floor. Unassign a Maximo Manage Location from a MIST Building From the Action menu (⋮) for the required MIST Building, select Unassign Location . Click Unassign Location to complete the action. The selected Maximo Manage Location is successfully unassigned from the corresponding MIST Building.
